summary: The close-pair shape trial is locked and not run. On 2022/23-2025/26, Gameweeks 5-38, one pair per position is the score leader and the closest eligible player within 0.5. The mean arm is how often the leader scores more. The shape arm counts earlier blanks at 2 points or fewer and hauls at 8 or more, with no standard deviation. A shape is ahead only if it beats the mean by 0.05 in every season with at least 80 decisive pairs. Ahead does not change score_xp.
